# aap_eda_credential_type (Data Source)

Get eda_credential_type datasource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aap_credential_type" "example-id" {
  id = "5"
}

data "aap_credential_type" "example-name" {
  name = "Basic Event Stream"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Crdential type ID.
- `name` (String) Credential type name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Credential type description.
- `injectors` (String) Enter injectors using either JSON syntax with `jsonencode()`. Must be alphabetized by key. Refer to the Ansible Controller documentation for example syntax.
- `inputs` (String) Enter inputs using JSON syntax wrapped with `jsonencode()`. Must be alphabetized by key. Refer to the Ansible Controller documentation for example syntax.
- `kind` (String)
- `namespace` (String)
